FINANCIAL ANALYST – VALUATION INSIGHTS: COST, fiscal year ended 2026-08-30

Basis: the supplied facts, supplied calculations, latest-quarter release and peer facts only. I did no arithmetic in the model. Supplied calculations are labelled "computed, rechecked given calculations".

1) CASH GENERATION – SUPPORTED
- Operating cash flow was 15,817,000,000 [XBRL tag NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093]. The prior year was 13,335,000,000 [same tag, period end 2025-08-31, filing 0000909832-25-000101].
- Capital spending was 6,435,000,000 [XBRL tag PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093]. The prior year was 5,498,000,000 [same tag, period end 2025-08-31, filing 0000909832-25-000101].
- Free cash flow, computed, rechecked given calculations: 15817000000 - 6435000000 = 9,382,000,000 USD. Inputs: [XBRL tag NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093] and [XBRL tag PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093].
- Growth was funded by internal cash flow, and capex rose alongside it. No prior-year free cash flow was supplied (see calculator_requests).

2) PROFITABILITY – SUPPORTED, WITH A THIN-MARGIN CAVEAT
- Operating margin, computed, rechecked given calculations: 11685000000 / 303154000000 = 3.8544766026507977%. Inputs: [XBRL tag OperatingIncomeLoss, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093] and [XBRL tag RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093].
- Return on average equity, computed, rechecked given calculations: 9226000000 / ((35803000000 + 29164000000) / 2) = 28.402111841396398%. Definition as supplied: reported net income fact divided by the simple average of current and prior year-end stockholders' equity. Inputs: [XBRL tag NetIncomeLoss, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093]; [XBRL tag StockholdersEquity, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093]; [XBRL tag StockholdersEquity, period end 2025-08-31, filing 0000909832-25-000101].
- Noncontrolling interest income is "not stated in the files" (tag null). Net income attributable to parent equals net income at 9,226,000,000 [XBRL tag NetIncomeLoss, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093], so the ROE numerator is not affected by a noncontrolling-interest adjustment.
- Prior-year operating margin was not supplied, so margin change is not assessed. Operating income was 11,685,000,000 versus 10,383,000,000 [XBRL tag OperatingIncomeLoss, period ends 2026-08-30 and 2025-08-31, filings 0000909832-26-000093 and 0000909832-25-000101].
- Peer operating margins as supplied; periods are not aligned, see Valuation: WMT 4.182073382943311% (period end 2026-01-31), TGT 4.8835655659477% (period end 2026-01-31), BJ 3.8057210808791457% (period end 2026-01-31). Same definition (operating income / revenue), but the Costco year ends seven months later and WMT's revenue tag is Revenues, not RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax.

3) FUNDING RISK – SUPPORTED (LOW LEVERAGE), WITH A MATURITY-TIMING FLAG
- Debt to equity, computed, rechecked given calculations: (3914000000 + 2248000000) / 35803000000 = 0.17210848252939698 ratio.
- Components included: LongTermDebtNoncurrent 3,914,000,000 [XBRL tag LongTermDebtNoncurrent, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093] and LongTermDebtCurrent 2,248,000,000 [XBRL tag LongTermDebtCurrent, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093]. Equity was 35,803,000,000 [XBRL tag StockholdersEquity, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093].
- Excluded per the supplied definition: repos, secured financings, and lease liabilities not captured by the selected debt tags.
- ShortTermBorrowings for Costco is "not stated in the files" (filing null).
- The mix shifted. Current portion was 2,248,000,000 versus 75,000,000 a year earlier [XBRL tag LongTermDebtCurrent, period ends 2026-08-30 and 2025-08-31, filings 0000909832-26-000093 and 0000909832-25-000101]. Noncurrent debt was 3,914,000,000 versus 5,713,000,000 [XBRL tag LongTermDebtNoncurrent, same periods and filings]. More debt is due within a year, but 15,817,000,000 of operating cash flow is the funding source cited above.

4) VALUATION – MIXED (PEER P/E NOT AVAILABLE; PRICE SOURCE LIMITED)
- P/E, computed, rechecked given calculations: 992.13 / 20.76 = 47.79046242774566 ratio. EPS input: [XBRL tag EarningsPerShareDiluted, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093], 20.76 versus 18.21 prior year.
- Price source: user-supplied --price at run time 2026-11-05T08:45:47-05:00. The market quote timestamp was not provided, so the price date is unverified.
- Peer P/E is "not stated in the files": no peer prices were supplied. Peer diluted EPS is supplied: WMT 2.73 [XBRL tag EarningsPerShareDiluted, period end 2026-01-31, filing 0000104169-26-000055]; TGT 8.13 [period end 2026-01-31, filing 0000027419-26-000016]; BJ 4.38 [period end 2026-01-31, filing 0001531152-26-000007].
- Comparability limits: peer fiscal periods end 2026-01-31, versus Costco's 2026-08-30. WMT's fiscal year is labelled fy 2026 and TGT/BJ fy 2025. No peer valuation conclusion is drawn.

5) LATEST QUARTER (quarter ended 2026-08-30; release accession 0000909832-26-000084)
- Total revenue was 95,723 versus 86,156 (USD as shown) [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L83-L85; quote: "Total revenue\n95,723\n86,156"].
- Quarter revenue growth, computed, rechecked given calculations: (95723.0 - 86156.0) / 86156.0 * 100 = 11.104275964529458%. Full-year revenue growth, computed, rechecked given calculations: (303154000000 - 275235000000) / 275235000000 = 10.143695387577887%. Inputs: [XBRL tag RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, period ends 2026-08-30 and 2025-08-31, filings 0000909832-26-000093 and 0000909832-25-000101].
- Quarter GAAP diluted EPS was $6.75 versus $5.87 [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L44; quote: "Net income for the fourth quarter was $2.998 billion, $6.75 per diluted share, compared to $2.610 billion, $5.87 per diluted share, last year."].
- EPS context: the quarter "was positively impacted by a non-recurring benefit of $0.15 per diluted share from IEEPA tariff refunds received in the quarter, less partial reinvestment of those refunds in increased member values" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L44]. Computed, rechecked given calculations: 0.15 / 20.76 * 100 = 0.722543352601156% of fiscal-year diluted EPS. Inputs: [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L44] and [XBRL tag EarningsPerShareDiluted, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093]. The one-time item is small relative to full-year EPS, so it does not explain the headline EPS growth. adjusted_eps_flags is empty.

6) WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY VIEW
- Measure: free cash flow. Current value is 9,382,000,000 (computed, rechecked given calculations: 15817000000 - 6435000000) for the year ended 2026-08-30 [XBRL tags NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities and PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, filing 0000909832-26-000093].
- Capex rose to 6,435,000,000 from 5,498,000,000. If the next reported annual free cash flow falls below 9,382,000,000 because capex keeps rising faster than operating cash flow, I would downgrade cash generation to mixed. That would matter more at a 47.79046242774566 P/E and with 2,248,000,000 of debt now current.

Insight: Costco's fiscal 2026 growth was funded internally: after 6,435,000,000 of capital spending, free cash flow was 9,382,000,000, even as the current portion of long-term debt rose to 2,248,000,000 from 75,000,000. [Computed, rechecked given calculations: 15817000000 - 6435000000 = 9,382,000,000 USD; inputs [XBRL tag NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093] and [XBRL tag PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093]; debt: [XBRL tag LongTermDebtCurrent, period end 2026-08-30, filing 0000909832-26-000093] versus [XBRL tag LongTermDebtCurrent, period end 2025-08-31, filing 0000909832-25-000101]]

calculator_requests.description: Peer debt to equity and return on average equity using definitions matching Costco's (state which debt components are included, e.g. WMT short-term borrowings 6,596,000,000 and current portion 3,542,000,000). Peer period ends are 2026-01-31, so label them as not period-aligned with Costco.
calculator_requests.formula: D/E = (long-term debt + current portion [+ short-term borrowings if included, stated explicitly]) / year-end equity; ROE = net income attributable to parent / simple average of current and prior year-end equity
